verified.note: Total energy, t = 1, H = -t sum (c+c + h.c.) + w sum b+b + g sum n_i (b+_i + b_i) (RULES.md 2.1). Cutoff 40 on the total phonon number; the next smaller cutoff gives -2.8343490235198288 (M = 32). Ohgoe & Imada (Table I) compare with the exact diagonalization of Marsiglio, -2.8343, which this energy reproduces; their best VMC row, -2.796(1), lies 0.038 above it.
